findings.title: A `pass` verdict over a `major` is only respected when the profile's pass_score allows it
findings.detail: The Decision says a `pass` carrying a real `major` "is not blocked by that alone", and AC1 pins the case at score 85 ⇒ `pass`. That only holds for `balanced` (80) and `frugal` (70). Under `thorough` (pass_score 90), one `major` gives 85 < 90, so the outcome is `fix` with `score_only`, and the `pass over major` note never fires. Say this explicitly, and add a parametrized case per profile to AC1.

findings.title: Single-reviewer brief is under-specified when a `fix` verdict does not survive but the score is low
findings.detail: With multiple reviewers, a non-surviving `fix` verdict's own `fix_brief` is excluded. With exactly one reviewer, the brief "keeps ... its own fix_brief verbatim", and the score line and bullets are added only when that brief is empty. Consider a single reviewer with a `fix` verdict over only `minor` findings and a score below `pass_score`. It is unclear whether the reviewer's brief is used verbatim without the score line (and so ignores the score rule) or is dropped as in the multi-reviewer case. Pin one behaviour and test it.

findings.title: Fields of a merged finding other than severity and personas are not defined
findings.detail: The merged finding keeps the highest severity and a canonical id. The spec does not say which copy supplies `detail`, `files`, `ac` and `category` for the brief bullets, the `must_fix` entries and the `advisory` entries that SPEC-0207 consumes. The same gap affects the `pass over major` note when a merged finding has several reporters. Say they come from the canonical copy.

findings.title: "Missing weight keys" cannot occur after the delta merge
findings.detail: The Design says weights are validated after merging over defaults, so a missing key cannot happen through `resolve_profile`. Reword AC2 to "unknown/extra weight keys", or state that it applies to hand-built profile dicts.

findings.title: The claim that SPEC-0201's e2e scripts keep their outcomes is unverified
findings.detail: The Decision asserts this because their `fix` verdicts carry `must_fix`/`major` or no finding. The implementer should confirm it against `tests/test_agentic_e2e.py` rather than trust the statement, and AC5 should say that existing e2e cases stay green.
